description: This file contains the PHP source code for the class 'Setting' within the 'Opencart\Admin\Model\Setting' namespace. It implements methods to get, update, and delete configuration settings from the database, serving as the model component for managing settings in the OpenCart admin module.

classes.name: Setting
classes.description: Model class for managing settings within the OpenCart admin area.

methods.name: getSettings
methods.description: Retrieves all settings for a given store ID, returning an array of key-value pairs.

methods.name: getSetting
methods.description: Retrieves specific settings identified by code and store ID, decoding serialized data if necessary.

methods.name: editSetting
methods.description: Updates or inserts multiple settings entries associated with a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSetting
methods.description: Deletes all settings associated with a specific code and store ID.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByCode
methods.description: Deletes all settings entries with a specific code.

methods.name: deleteSettingsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all settings entries associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Fetches the value of a specific setting key for a given store ID.

methods.name: editValue
methods.description: Updates or inserts a specific setting key-value pair for a store and code.
